name: solvela-mcp
description: Pay for LLM API calls with USDC on Solana — no API keys, no accounts, just a wallet.
long_description:
Solvela exposes a pay-per-call LLM gateway as MCP tools: chat with 44+ models across 6 providers, smart routing, web search, and Solana price data — all paid per request with USDC-SPL via the x402 protocol.

No signup required. On first run the server auto-creates a non-custodial wallet at ~/.solvela/wallet.json (or uses the key you provide below). The private key never leaves your machine; only signed transactions reach the gateway. Fund the printed address with USDC on Solana to start — network gas is covered by the gateway's SOL drip, so you never need SOL.

solana_wallet_key.title: Solana wallet key (optional)
solana_wallet_key.description: Base58 secret key of an existing wallet. Leave empty to auto-create a non-custodial wallet at ~/.solvela/wallet.json on first run. The key never leaves this machine.

session_budget.title: Session budget (USDC, optional)
session_budget.description: Maximum USDC to spend per session, e.g. 1.00. Leave empty for no session cap.

solana_rpc_url.title: Solana RPC URL
solana_rpc_url.description: RPC endpoint used to submit signed transactions.

gateway_url.title: Gateway URL
gateway_url.description: Solvela gateway endpoint. Only change this if you run your own gateway.

tools.name: chat
tools.description: Chat with any supported LLM model, paid per call in USDC

tools.name: wallet_status
tools.description: Wallet address, USDC balance, and gateway health

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List available models and per-token pricing

tools.name: spending
tools.description: Session spend summary and budget remaining
